title: Join clean names
prompt: Implement `public static string JoinNames(List<string> names)`. Trim each name, omit names that are whitespace-only, then join the remaining names with comma and space. Preserve order and duplicates. Do not modify the input list. The list and its items are nonnull.
hints: What should happen to a name containing only spaces after Trim?
Build a separate list of cleaned names, adding only names whose trimmed text is nonempty.
Use a loop to collect trimmed nonempty names, then return `String.Join(", ", cleaned)` without changing the input.
checkLabels: Names must be trimmed and joined with comma and space.
Duplicate names and their order must be preserved.
An empty list must produce an empty string.
A list containing only whitespace must produce an empty string.
The method must leave the input list unchanged.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Includes blank values in the joined result.
Cleans the supplied list in place.

feedback: Build a separate list. Handle null before calling Trim, and skip a trimmed value with length zero.
